patthana18.20:1.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavavippayutto na anāsavo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana18.20:2.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. hetuyā cattāri,
patthana18.20:3.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na sāsavo na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā dve.
